title: GEOF Metric Definition
description: What a reading means. Immutable; a change to statistical unit, numerator, denominator, eligibility, de-duplication or aggregation is a new version. A metric identifier names a definition, never a reading. Definitions carry no preferred direction: the framework assigns no desirability to any value.

basis.description: outcome: derived from Observations. condition: a state of the Object or its carrier (crawl permission, structured data coverage, Core Web Vitals, licensing terms).

statUnit.description: The unit counted: run, answer, object-in-answer, recipient, call, crawl, citation, period, ...

numerator.description: Required for ratio and share types: what is counted above

denominator.description: Required for ratio and share types: what is counted below

eligibility.description: Which units qualify for the denominator (completed answers only, answers in the prompt set, recipients in the intended audience, ...)

dedup.description: De-duplication rule (per run, per recipient per day, per citation URL after canonicalization, ...)

aggregation.description: How instance values combine (mean, sum, share, distribution, max)

unit.description: Unit of the value when not implied by valueType (seconds, wei, ...)

requires.description: Statement fields this definition makes mandatory beyond the family defaults
